create_torchbeast_client: create a torchbeast Client instance connected to localhost:12345 for remote function calls
connect_client_workers: connect the torchbeast client with a specified number of workers to the server
call_myfunc_remote: call the remote myfunc function on the client passing a numpy float32 array
call_pyfunc_remote: call the remote pyfunc function on the client passing a numpy float32 array
test_identity_and_batched_identity: test the client identity and batched_identity methods by asserting numpy array equality
